summary: The user replaced the adsorption maximum-force zero-tolerance rule with a tiered gate. Aggregate RMSE and p95 remain hard non-regression guards; a vector-maximum increase within both 0.005 eV/A and 2% is a soft warning eligible for candidate evaluation. Job-1506 epoch 6 is now a warning-eligible candidate, not a promoted checkpoint.

payload.objective: Obtain separate authorization to evaluate the reclassified epoch-6 MatRIS warning candidate on the frozen TS held-out set; do not promote it or rerun the path meanwhile.
current_evidence: The active adsorption-retention gate now has PASS, SOFT_WARNING, and FAIL outcomes rather than zero-tolerance rejection of every vector-maximum increase.
Component RMSE, vector RMSE, and vector p95 remain hard non-regression metrics.
A vector-maximum increase is SOFT_WARNING only when it is no greater than both 0.005 eV/A and 2%; exceeding either limit is FAIL.
SOFT_WARNING may enter checkpoint-candidate evaluation but never authorizes checkpoint promotion or complete-path rerun.
Under the revised gate, job-1506 epochs 2-6 are warning-eligible and epochs 1 and 7-12 fail.
The retained selection rule chooses epoch 6 because it has the lowest optimizer mean-total-loss among warning-eligible epochs.
Epoch 6 improves adsorption component RMSE, vector RMSE, and p95; its vector maximum increases by 0.003355 eV/A or 1.310976%, within the warning band.
Epoch-6 checkpoint 8e53cfb0...eb49 strictly reloads with 4,294,897 finite parameters.
Frozen TS held-out inference has not been run for epoch 6, and no new GPU job, checkpoint promotion, or path rerun occurred.
payload.one_executable_step: After separate explicit user authorization, run exact epoch-6 inference on the frozen seven-structure TS held-out set and review its six-structure primary force and relative-energy metrics before any promotion decision.
payload.submission_boundary: The gate change and reclassification authorize no GPU inference, checkpoint promotion, complete-path rerun, AQCat25 audit, VASP, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action.
done_when: Epoch-6 predictions are compared with the frozen TS VASP labels without training or selection leakage.
A work-side review decides whether the warning candidate passes TS force and relative-energy limits.
Checkpoint promotion and complete-path rerun remain separate decisions.
